evidence.quote: The Alamo Drafthouse Theater is good food, good beer and good film, all at the same place!
Seating in every Alamo Drafthouse location is similar to what you'll find in traditional theaters
Entertainment purchases include ticket purchases at movie theaters
Each Alamo Drafthouse location's menu features burgers, pizzas, salads, snacks and desserts

draft.notes: The site is primarily a cinema offering movie tickets and in-theater food and drinks. Physical-goods status relies on its Shop AlamoMart link and merchandise/collectibles references; shipping or pickup is not explicitly stated.
